lines: Without even a tear left to shed
Leaving no trace of the days we spent
In the morning I met alone
The words that slipped out before I knew it
In the morning I met alone
Someone crosses my mind, a sudden longing
Of the days we spent together
This is just an ordinary love story, isn't it
We drifted further and further apart
That too is just a familiar, well-worn story
Even on those days that shone so bright
Walk the road that leads to goodbye
It spilled out and fell away
The things we couldn't understand about each other
In the words that slipped out before I knew it
And still, time after time, surely
If only we could return to the beginning
In the words that never reached you, that spilled out
